procedure.method: Independent fresh-session editorial assessment restricted to the explicitly pinned inputs. I read the complete literal request, case, rubric, rules, compact addendum and method/schema instructions, checked the declared pins, and read all five pinned production manifests without following their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts. I actually displayed each exact poster file through tools.view_image with detail original, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All fifteen displays were complete before the first poster copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. After that complete pass I retained all twelve actual first readings for each image in packet copy order. For dash-class ambiguity I actually reopened each member's same pinned native view once, in M1–M5 order; the M5 opening also inspected its deadline word spaces. Thus there were fifteen initial poster displays and five ambiguity revisit displays. Copy arrays preserve the first readings and exact revisit bindings, including the unresolved M3 stroke class. Ratings and set diversity were judged from the pixels after the complete viewing pass. Successful helper exits, hashes and filenames were not treated as semantic viewing. No source opens were needed or claimed, no peer/producer/planner records were read, no images were edited or created, and no runtime session identity or serialized opening event was invented.
